subject: Polity of Bihar
description: Eduteria Bihar Tathya Sangrah · Polity of Bihar

questions.q: Who among the following has NOT been the Chief Minister of Bihar?
questions.source: Eduteria PYQ set — CDPO Preliminary Exam 2005 (BH-EDU-086)

questions.q:
Match 

List-I with 

List-II :
a. Governor of Bihar
b. Chief Justice of Bihar
c. Chief Minister of Bihar
d. Chief Electoral Officer of Bihar (1. Mr. Nitish Kumar, 2. Mr. H. R. Srinivas, 3. Mr. Sanjay Karol, 4. Mr. Fagu Chauhan)
questions.explanation: Correct answer: a-4, b-3, c-1, d-2.

questions.q: Among the following who has been Speaker of Lok Sabha prior to his Election as President of India?
Who was the Chief Justice of the Patna High Court who administered the oath of office to Mr. Fagu Chauhan as the Governor of Bihar in July 2019?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Hon. A. P. Sahi.

questions.q: Which community was categorized as Scheduled Caste (SC) by a 2015 Bihar government notification which was quashed in July 2024 by the Supreme Court, ruling that states cannot make changes to the SC list published under Article 341 of the Constitution?
Who is the constitutional head of the state government of Bihar?
questions.explanation: The Governor is the constitutional head of the state. The Governor is appointed by the President and holds office during the pleasure of the President.

questions.q: Under which Article can the Governor promulgate ordinances when the legislature is not in session?
questions.explanation: Article 213 gives the Governor the power to promulgate ordinances. Article 200 deals with assent to bills and Article 356 with President's rule.
Bihar has a bicameral legislature — the Legislative Assembly (lower house, 243 seats) and the Legislative Council (upper house, 75 seats).

questions.q: The Bihar Legislative Council is a permanent house; what fraction of its members retire every two years?
questions.explanation: The Legislative Council is a permanent house; one-third of its members retire every two years. Members serve a tenure of 6 years.

questions.q: Which Article governs the formation and creation of the State Legislative Council?
questions.explanation: Article 169 provides for the creation/abolition of the Legislative Council; its structure is described in Article 171. The Legislative Assembly is described under Article 170.

questions.q: The real executive head of the state who is appointed by the Governor is:
questions.explanation: The Governor appoints the Chief Minister (leader of the majority party in the Assembly) under Article 164. The Chief Minister is the real head of the state executive.

questions.q: Who administers the oath of office to the Chief Minister of Bihar?

options.D: Chief Justice of the High Court

questions.explanation: The Governor administers the oath of office and secrecy to the Chief Minister. The Chief Justice of the High Court is sworn in by the Governor.

questions.q: In Bihar, reservation for women in Panchayati Raj institutions is:
questions.explanation: Reservation for women is 50% in Panchayati Raj institutions (from 2006), 50% in urban local bodies (from 2007), and 35% in Bihar Police/other government services.

questions.q: Which Act provided the three-tier urban local self-government in Bihar (Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Council, Municipal Corporation)?
questions.explanation: The Bihar Municipal Act 2007 provides a three-tier structure of urban self-governance — Nagar Panchayat, Municipal Council (Nagar Parishad) and Municipal Corporation (Nagar Nigam).

questions.q: What is the total number of Urban Local Bodies in Bihar at present?
questions.explanation: Bihar has 261 Urban Local Bodies — 19 Municipal Corporations, 88 Municipal Councils and 154 Nagar Panchayats.

questions.q: Who is the highest law officer of the state, appointed by the Governor under Article 165?

options.C: Chief Justice of the High Court

questions.explanation: The Advocate General, provided by Article 165, is the highest law officer of the state, appointed by the Governor; he may speak in the legislature but has no right to vote.

questions.q: The Patna High Court was constituted on which date?
questions.explanation: The Patna High Court was constituted on 3 February 1916. Its first Chief Justice was Sir Edward Maynard Des Champs Chamier.

questions.q: In which election year, after Jharkhand's separation (2000), did Bihar's Legislative Assembly seats become 243?
questions.explanation: After Jharkhand was separated on 15 November 2000, the number of seats in the Bihar Legislative Assembly remained at 243.

questions.q: Which leader was the first Chief Minister of independent Bihar (1952 general elections)?
questions.explanation: Shri Krishna Singh was the first Chief Minister of independent Bihar. (Mohammad Yunus was the first Chief Minister/Prime Minister under British rule in 1937.)
